title: wasm-slm-edge-cloud-bench: Quantized small-LLM inference across the WebAssembly edge-cloud boundary
description: Per-request latency/memory measurements, benchmark harness, and stratified prompt set for TinyLlama-1.1B and Qwen2.5-0.5B (Q4_K_M, Q8_0, F16) served via WasmEdge/WASI-NN (LlamaEdge) on a Docker-capped edge profile and a cloud VM. Includes discarded runs documenting LlamaEdge 0.29.0 generation-cap defects.
